context: The present invention relates to the sphere of pharmaceutics, in particular to the treatment and/or prevention of an HIV infection. Claimed is a patient pack comprising (1S,4R)-cis-4-[2-amino-6-(cyclopropylamino)-9H-purin-9-yl]-2-cyclopentene-1-methanol and (2R,cis)-4-amino-1-(2-hydroxymethyl-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl)-(1H)-pyrimidin-2-one or (2R,cis)-4-amino-5-fluoro-1-(2-hydroxymethyl-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl)-(1H)-pyrimidin-2-one or physiologically functional derivatives thereof. Furthermore, the invention relates to a pharmaceutical formulation comprising (1S,4R)-cis-4-[2-amino-6-(cyclopropylamino)-9H-purin-9-yl]-2-cyclopentene-1-methanol and (2R,cis)-4-amino-1-(2-hydroxymethyl-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl)-(1H)-pyrimidin-2-one in combination with one or more pharmaceutically acceptable carriers, as well as to a method for the treatment or prevention of the symptoms or effects of an HIV infection in an infected animal which provides for the use of said patient pack and pharmaceutical formulation. Also described is the use of (1S,4R)-cis-4-[2-amino-6-(cyclopropylamino)-9H-purin-9-yl]-2-cyclopentene-1-methanol either simultaneously or sequentially with: a) zidovudine and (2R,cis)-4-amino-1-(2-hydroxymethyl-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl)-(1H)-pyrimidin-2-one, or b) zidovudine and (2R,cis)-4-amino-5-fluoro-1-(2-hydroxymethyl-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl)-(1H)-pyrimidin-2-one, and of the patient pack comprising the combinations of said compounds in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment and/or prevention of an HIV infection.
